Opposing fans shouldn't be allowed to buy tickets

Not online direct from the team, no. This allows the locals to get first dibs on the tickets. For the record, that was squat to me. I had a presale code for the first batch of tickets released (9am) and those sold out in under 3 minutes. I didn't get any and nobody else I knew - locals - managed to score any direct from the team. Everyone I know, fans of the home team or the visiting team, has had to buy from the secondary market.

In previous rounds, away fans were able to call the box office and acquire tickets directly without a problem.

That's not what is going on here. Fans of the visiting team are welcome to wear their attire in all but 7% of the premium club/lounge seats in the arena and, I assure you, they will do so. There have literally been a handful of people impacted by this policy all playoffs and those were season ticket members of those seats who happen to have another team as a "primary" team.
